candidate_evidence.quote: evaluating the safety and tolerability of CUE-102 monotherapy in adult participants with Glioblastoma (GBM) at first recurrence

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: other WHO grade 4 malignant glioma or molecular GBM (based on the 2021 WHO Classification) at first recurrence.

coder_notes: HLA-A*0201 genotype is a required germline HLA type for the drug's restriction; per manual section 5 HLA type is not recorded as a tumour biomarker. Eligibility allows other WHO grade 4 malignant glioma, hence mixed_glioma_gbm_named.
